name: AI Grading Redesign
objective: Redesign AI scoring for short-answer and fill-blank types: structured JSON output (scores+reasoning+feedback per sub-question), grading table decomposition, Fritsch-Carlson calibration pipeline, strictness presets, LLM-based problem decomposition, and frontend grading table editor/display.
exit_criteria: Grading table saves/loads correctly in both ProblemFillBlankConfig and ProblemShortAnswerConfig
AI decompose endpoint returns reasonable sub-question breakdowns from problem descriptions
Short-answer AI grading returns per-sub-question JSON with scores, reasoning, and feedback
Fill-blank AI grading treats each blank as a sub-question with per-blank scores
Calibration pipeline applies correct spline anchors and strictness preset per sub-question
Grading table UI on create/edit page supports add/edit/delete rows, strictness pills, AI decompose
Submission result page displays grading table with per-sub-question scores and feedback
Backward compatible: grading_table=None preserves old single-case grading behavior
Retry on HTTP 429/500/502/503/504 with exponential backoff (1s, 5s, 25s), max 3 retries
